findings.issue: Workspace slug dedup loop in workspaces service has no max-attempt guard — while(true) can hang forever
findings.impact: If all slug variants are taken (e.g., 'workspace-1' through 'workspace-100'), the loop spins indefinitely — potential DoS
findings.fix: Add MAX_ATTEMPTS=100 counter and throw error after exhausting attempts — already done in workspaces/service.ts but CHECK channels/service.ts has NO safeguard

findings.issue: No optimistic locking on any PATCH handler — no If-Match header, no version column, no checkVersionMatch pattern
findings.impact: Concurrent edits silently overwrite each other — last writer wins with no conflict detection
findings.fix: Add version column (INT DEFAULT 1) to messages, workspaces, channels tables; implement If-Match header check in PATCH handlers; return 409 on version mismatch

findings.issue: webhook_endpoints.created_by FK has no ON DELETE action — defaults to RESTRICT
findings.impact: Deleting an auth user who created webhooks will fail with FK violation; user deletion cascading is blocked
findings.fix: Add ON DELETE SET NULL or ON DELETE CASCADE to the FK constraint

findings.issue: TypeScript types severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 interfaces defined vs 16 tables; soft-delete fields missing from Workspace/Channel/Message types
findings.impact: Type-safety gaps across codebase; developers must use 'any' for non-existent types; schema drift goes undetected
findings.fix: Run supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/db/src/types.ts; add CI check for type-schema drift

findings.issue: Soft-delete on workspaces/channels/messages does not cascade soft-delete to child records (channel_members, messages in workspace, reactions on soft-deleted messages)
findings.impact: Orphaned channel_members point to deleted channels; reactions on soft-deleted messages remain; workspace soft-delete leaves all channels/messages undeleted
findings.fix: Add trigger to cascade soft-delete: workspace soft-delete -> soft-delete all channels -> soft-delete all messages; channel soft-delete -> soft-delete all messages

findings.issue: Missing index on reactions.message_id — all reaction queries filter by message_id but no index exists
findings.impact: Full table scans on every reaction fetch; O(n) per message on reaction-heavy channels

findings.issue: Workspace creation is multi-table (workspaces + workspace_members + webhook trigger) but NOT wrapped in a DB transaction
findings.impact: If workspace_members insert succeeds but subsequent operations fail, partial state exists — orphan workspace or missing member records
findings.fix: Wrap workspace creation in Supabase RPC with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, or use application-level compensating actions

findings.issue: Missing composite index on channel_members (channel_id, user_id) — private channel access checks use this pair
findings.impact: Slow channel access checks on private channels with many members
findings.fix: CREATE INDEX idx_channel_members_channel_user ON public.channel_members(channel_id, user_id)

findings.issue: No down/rollback scripts for any of 26 migrations — forward-fix is only recovery path
findings.impact: Schema rollback requires PITR with data loss; no automated way to reverse a migration
findings.fix: Write .down.sql scripts for all 26 migrations; mandate down scripts in migration template
